name: sqd-portal-mcp
description: Query blockchain data through the hosted SQD Portal MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Query indexed blockchain data from SQD Portal
interface.longDescription: Use the hosted SQD Portal MCP server from Codex to discover supported networks, inspect indexed blockchain state, resolve token and contract entities, and run read-only analytics across EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Substrate, and Hyperliquid data.
defaultPrompt: List the SQD Portal networks available for Base and Ethereum.
Resolve the SQD token on Base and show query-ready filters.
Summarize recent activity for a wallet using SQD Portal data.
